name: Chives
shortDescription: Fine green stems and round purple flowers.
description: Chives are a clump-forming herb with slender, onion-flavoured leaves. Their purple flowers are edible and attract pollinators.
use: Bread and butter, eggs, potatoes, salads and dips.
growingTips: Grow in sun or partial shade and water during dry spells. Snip leaves close to the base to encourage fresh growth.
alt: Green chive stems and purple flowers
